review_notes: I read the whole target file, which has three theorems and no simp attributes of its own. I checked its only simp-set interaction, the `simpa only [...]` at line 43. I traced `iterateSpatialWord_zero` in IteratesWordTimeEnergy.lean and `iterateSpatialWord` in IteratesWordDiffusion.lean. I also grepped every use of the lemma in the repository. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about observed simp behaviour. The `dsimp only` and `rw` steps in the energy bound are explicit, targeted rewrites, and I found nothing wrong with them as a simp interface. I did not inspect `amnrMaterial` or `spaceLap` for missing simp lemmas.

findings.excerpt: simpa only [iterateSpatialWord_zero, Pi.zero_apply, zero_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, zero_add] using he
findings.problem: The canonical normalisation `iterateSpatialWord w (fun _ => 0) = fun _ => 0` is not a simp lemma. `iterateSpatialWord_zero` is a plain theorem, and its definition has no `@[simp]` attribute. Every user has to list it by name in `simp only`: here, in IteratesWordFluxTimeEnergy.lean line 161, and in IteratesHomogeneousGradientMaterial.lean line 46. In the third place the following plain `simp` call works only after a manual `simp only [iterateSpatialWord_zero]` and an `unfold spaceGrad`. The target file is forced into a hand-built `simpa only` list. That list also bundles unrelated algebra (`zero_sub`, `sub_eq_add_neg`, `zero_add`) just to turn the zero forcing term into the desired shape.
findings.proposed_change: Mark `iterateSpatialWord_zero` in IteratesWordTimeEnergy.lean with `@[simp]`. The left side is a definite head pattern `iterateSpatialWord _ (fun _ => 0)`, and the right side `fun _ => 0` is smaller, so I see no rewrite cycle. Then the proof at line 43 can be shortened to `simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using he`, or to a plain `simpa using he` if default simp lemmas already give the needed shape for the negated error term. I have not tested either replacement, so the exact simp set may need adjusting. Other callers could likewise drop the explicit name.
findings.benefit: The zero-data normal form fires automatically in all downstream material, flux and gradient-energy proofs, so each one no longer has to name the lemma. The proof at line 43 would also no longer depend on a fragile hand-picked rewrite list.
